title: Dick Harper falsified personnel records
summary: Scott Ramsay tells of Dick Harper falsified personnel records, about 1948 at New Mexico (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He said, "Well, roughly [music] 200 people were involved in the whole Aztec recovery, so I kept 200 personnel records to make sure nobody was ever really an Aztec."

plain: A man named Scott Ramsay passes on what he says a man named Dick Harper told him about a crashed craft that people say was recovered near Aztec, New Mexico, around 1948. According to Ramsay, Harper said about 200 people took part in the recovery, so he kept 200 personnel records, the files that track where military staff served, so that nobody would ever really show up as having been at Aztec. If true, it would mean the recovery's paper trail was hidden on purpose.
